name: agent-gateway
description: The open verifier of the Agentic Trust dual (ADR-69/70). Wires Claude Code to the hosted Agentic Trust gateway over remote HTTP MCP, so your agents' privileged calls are checked against MM-issued CIS-4 AgentAuthorityCredential / CIS-8004 identity records on Concordium at call time, including live revocation. Anonymous and rate-limited: no API key, no OAuth, no account. Every independent deployment widens enforcement coverage without touching the issuer's signing key.
